title: Herbal Light Malaysian Freekeh Soup
description: A fragrant, protein‑packed freekeh soup infused with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves and fresh herbs, perfect for a post‑workout recovery meal.
instructions: Rinse the freekeh under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a large pot, combine the freekeh and vegetable broth and bring to a rolling boil.
Add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, ginger, and minced garlic, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes until the freekeh is tender and the soup has thickened slightly.
Remove the pot from heat and strain the soup through a fine‑mesh sieve; return the liquid to the pot.
Stir in salt and lime juice, adjusting seasoning to taste.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with chopped coriander, mint, and a drizzle of sesame oil if desired.
Serve hot, optionally adding sliced chili for heat.
If you prefer a cooler option, let the soup cool to room temperature and refrigerate, though it remains delicious warm.
